title: Eddoboozi Eryasoomooza Obufuzi bw'Ekifaananyi
intro: Mu babaka b’Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna mwalimu omuweereza omunywevu eyasituka mu ggwanga ery’obukakanyavu okutuusa amazima. Abantu baabwe baali beettanira katonda omuyiiya, nga bava ku Mutonzi w’ebintu byonna ebiriwo. Mu bumalirivu obutasalako, ono ssekinnoomu yabakubira essimu — naye obubaka bwasisinkanibwa n’okwegaana n’okugaanibwa. Yitamu mu bikozesebwa okuzuula omuweereza ono eyeewaddeyo y’ani.
clues: Nasindikibwa ng’omubaka eri abantu abakakanyavu abaali bataayaaya wala okuva ku kkubo eggolokofu.
Najja okujjukiza eggwanga lyange Oyo eyatonda byonna ebiriwo — asinga abatonzi bonna.
Abantu bange baali bakyuse ne badda ku kifaananyi eky’obulimba kye baasinzanga era ne bakoowoola emisana n’ekiro.
Nnabasoomooza n’obuvumu, nga mmubuuza lwaki bandisinza katonda omuyiiya ne basuula Mukama waabwe ow’amazima.
Banneegaana, ne bagaana okuwuliriza, ne banywerera ku bulimba bwabwe — naye Mukama wange yankuuma.
Nze Ilyas — era emirembe gyaweebwa ku nze, era nabalibwa mu baweereza abakkiriza ab’Omusaasizi ennyo.
